description: **Dieselbe Verbindungs-Ansicht wie `show_connections`, nur schlank ausgeliefert**: das Kartenwerk lädt die Ansicht als Skript, statt es mitzubringen. **Nimm dies nur, wenn ausdrücklich nach der schlanken Auslieferung gefragt wird** — sonst `show_connections`. Sonst unverändert: plant die Fahrt wie `connections` und liefert sie zusätzlich als Ansicht aus. **Pflicht sind BEIDE Endpunkte**, wie dort: `origin_id` UND `destination_id` — oder die vier Koordinaten-Felder; `render_payload` entfällt. Der Antwort-Text ist der von `connections`; die Rohdaten daneben tragen nur die Felder, die die Ansicht zeichnet, ihr Kartenverlauf davon im `_meta`. **Anleitung**: `get_usage_guide` mit `tool='connections'`. **Anti-Fab**: Linien, Zeiten, Halte und Gleise ausschließlich aus dem Output dieses Aufrufs.

lat.description: Breite eines Orts ohne Id, mit `lon`.

stay_minutes.description: Mindest-Aufenthalt, 0–1440 Minuten; macht den Halt zum Umstieg.

inputSchema.description:
Unified connection request. For stops, provide origin_id and destination_id.
For arbitrary locations (e.g. addresses, POIs), provide coordinates — and as
the one retry worth making when resolved ids find nothing: an id the routing
graph does not know answers empty rather than with an error.

`Default` is derived so a caller in a test can name the two or three fields
its case is about; the request grows by optional fields often enough that
spelling out two dozen `None`s at every call site is its own source of noise.

access_modes.description:
Weg zur ersten Haltestelle: Einträge `fahrzeug[:own|sharing][:only|prefer]`, Fahrzeug
`walk`, `bike`, `scooter`, `car`, `taxi`; `own`/`sharing` eigenes/geliehenes (sonst
gleich wessen); `only` nur damit, `prefer` (Default) neben dem Fußweg.

accessibility_profile.description:
Mobility profile by name: `"Standard"` (default), `"WheelchairRobust"`,
`"WalkerComfort"` or `"IndividualComfort"`. Each bundles its accessibility
constraints and walk speed; another name is an argument error. Where the
wheelchair profiles find no stated step-free ride, `accessibility_routing`
says what the journeys beside it are. What each profile constrains is in the
usage guide.

accessibility_unknown.description:
Nur mit `WheelchairRobust`/`WalkerComfort`: `refuse` nimmt nur als stufenfrei
Ausgewiesenes, `admit` auch, worüber nichts bekannt ist. Weggelassen: siehe Anleitung.

bike_carriage.description:
Das Rad fährt auf jeder Fahrt mit: `true` nur auf Fahrten, die es bekanntlich
mitnehmen, `'allow_unknown'` auch ohne Angabe.

cancelled.description:
`exclude` (Default), `include` (dazu `broken_journeys` mit Grund) oder `mark` (dazu
jeder Halt beurteilt und wo neu zu suchen ist).

cycling_profile.description:
Wer auf dem Rad sitzt, und damit das Tempo der Rad-Abschnitte: `family`
(mit kleinen Kindern), `normal` (Default, unverändert) oder `ebike`
(Pedelec). Ein anderer Name ist ein Argument-Fehler.

cycling_speed.description:
Rad-Tempo in Metern/Sekunde, 1 bis 12 — außerhalb ein Argument-Fehler.
Überschreibt `cycling_profile`. Richtwerte: Familie ≈2.8, normal ≈5,
Pedelec ≈6.5.

egress_modes.description: Wie `access_modes`, für den Weg von der letzten Haltestelle.

exclude_lines.description:
Line blacklist, same token form as `only_lines`. A journey is dropped if
any transit leg uses one of them.

extended.description:
`true` keeps the map data in the text: every stop's coordinate, every
leg's polyline, and the whole stop sequence with them — for an application
that DRAWS the route, at two to three times the answer. A chat client
leaves it off.

format.description:
Answer serialisation: `"toon"` (default) or `"json"` — the detail is in
`get_usage_guide`. **An agent leaves this out.**

include_rental_bike.description:
`true` adds a rental-bike leg (park-and-bike / station rental). Equivalent
to naming `"bike"` in `modes` together with a transit mode.

is_arrival_time.description:
`true` reads `time` as the desired ARRIVAL time instead of the departure
time.

lang.description: Die Sprache der Namen: `'de'` (Vorgabe), `'it'`, `'fr'`, auch mit Region (`'de-CH'`).

limit.description:
Maximum number of journeys, at least 1. Default 5, values above 15 are
served as 15.

max_transfers.description:
Upper bound on interchanges: `0` = direct, up to `3`. Omit unless the user
constrains transfers: the backend then derives the search depth from the
trip's air-line distance and escalates it when the first attempt finds
nothing, so omitting never loses a connection.

max_walk_from_origin.description:
Höchstens so weit zu Fuß vom Start zur ersten Haltestelle, Meter über die Straße:
500, 1000, 2000 oder 5000 — anderes ist ein Argument-Fehler.

max_walk_meters.description:
Cap on the summed walking DISTANCE in metres. Works like
`max_walk_minutes`, on the metres walked.

max_walk_minutes.description:
Cap on the summed walking TIME in minutes: every journey of the answer
keeps to it.

max_walk_to_destination.description: Wie `max_walk_from_origin`, von der letzten Haltestelle zum Ziel.

mobility_profile.description:
How the first and the last mile may be covered, by name: `"transit"`
(default — both ends on foot), `"transit_plus_sharing"` (a shared bike),
`"door_to_door"` (being driven), `"park_and_ride"` or `"bike_and_ride"`
(one's OWN car or bicycle, left where the transit leg starts). Another name
is an argument error. It widens those two ends, restricts no ride and
promises nothing. When to set which, and how it composes with `modes`, is
in the usage guide.

modes.description:
Transport-mode restriction, not a preference: nothing outside the list is
planned. The footpath always stays allowed — the way to, from and between
stops goes on foot — while `["foot"]` on its own plans no ride at all.
Entries: `"bike"`, `"bike_rental"`, `"foot"`, `"car"`, `"taxi"`, `"scooter"`,
`"transit"`, `"bus"`, `"tram"`, `"rail"`, `"subway"`, `"ferry"`, `"air"`
(flights); several combine. An entry outside that list is an argument
error, not a dropped filter. Omitted or empty = all standard transit
modes, the ferry included, and a flight where one arrives sooner;
`"transit"` = the same without flights. Set only when the user insists on
a mode; the guide has the vocabulary and the traps.

no_change_at.description: Halt-Ids wie `origin_id`, an denen keine Verbindung umsteigt.

not_via.description: Halt-Ids wie `origin_id`, die keine Verbindung berührt.

only_lines.description:
Line whitelist. Entries are line tokens as printed on the vehicle (`"6"`,
`"U3"`); a journey is kept only if every transit leg uses one of them.

origin_id.description:
Origin id: the resolver's `main` id as handed out — for a stop a DHID (`de:NNNNN:NNN`,
`at:…`, `ch:…`, `it:…`) or a station id (`Parentch:1:sloid:3000`), else the address or POI id.
Resolve the place first — a name here is an argument error.

origin_lat.description:
Origin latitude, WGS-84 decimal degrees — the fallback when no id is at
hand, and the one retry worth making when resolved ids find nothing.

origin_type.description:
What `origin_id` is: `"stop"` (default), `"address"` or `"poi"`. The backend
resolves an address or a POI to its real name from the id.

prefer_flat.description:
`true` plant die hügel-ärmste statt der sonst gewählten Rad-Route: die
Suche gewichtet die Steigung und nimmt dafür Umwege in Kauf, nur auf
Rad-Abschnitten. Keine Zusage — ohne flachere Alternative kommt dieselbe
Route; die Höhenmeter der Antwort sagen es. Wann setzen: die Anleitung.

submodes_allow.description:
Fine submode whitelist — finer than `modes`, which only separates
bus/tram/rail/subway. Entries: `"sbahn"`, `"regionalbahn"`, `"ice"`,
`"ic"`, `"ir"`, `"nj"`, `"fernverkehr"`, `"stadtbahn"`, `"ubahn"`,
`"bus"`, `"regionalbus"`, `"stadtbus"`, `"flug"` (flights). A journey is
kept only if every transit leg matches one.

submodes_deny.description:
Fine submode blacklist, same vocabulary as `submodes_allow`. A journey is
dropped if any transit leg matches one.

taxi_pickup.description: Wo das Taxi die Fahrten trifft: `door` (Default, am Halt) oder `rank` (am Taxistand).

time.description:
ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g. `"2026-06-15T08:30:00Z"`). Omit to plan from now.
Resolve a spoken time with the time tool rather than computing one.

verbosity.description:
How much of each journey comes back: `"compact"` (default — everything an
answer is cited from) or `"full"` (adds the stops in between). A third
word is an argument error, not the default.

via_id.description:
Intermediate stop the route must pass through („über X"), as an id in the
same form as `origin_id`. The route is then planned A → via → B.

via_lat.description:
Via latitude, for an intermediate address or POI without an id. Goes with
`via_lon`.

vias.description:
Zwischenhalte in Reiserichtung, höchstens 4, statt `via_id`/`via_lat`/`via_lon`:
je `id`+`type` (wie ein Endpunkt) oder `lat`+`lon`, dazu `kind`, `stay_minutes`.

walk_speed.description:
Walking speed of the foot legs in metres/second, between 0.3 and 3 m/s —
outside that it is an argument error. Default ≈1.33, slow ≈0.7, brisk
≈2.0. Overrides the walk speed of `accessibility_profile`.
